field.name: returnSettlementRequired
field.description: Y: approving a return only creates its shipment, a return is received through WarehouseTaskServices.receive#ReturnItems, and credits, refunds and replacements come only from ReturnServices.settle#Return, for the quantity received. N, the default: Mantle responds at approval (immediate responses), at receipt and when the return shipment is delivered, as before.

field.name: salesInvoiceFinalizedAtShip
field.description: Y: the sales invoice made when an outgoing shipment is packed stays in process, with no payment applied, until the shipment ships, when it is finalized, applied the order's captured payments and sent; until then InvoiceServices.release#ShipmentDraftInvoice takes a reopened package's lines off it. N, the default: the invoice is finalized and paid at pack, as before.

field.name: originalInvoiceId
field.description: The sales invoice or supplier bill that billed the returned quantity.

field.name: receiptless
field.description: Y for a credit given without a receipt, with a reason and an approver holding RETURN_CREDIT_APPROVE.

field.name: operationKey
field.description: The settle#Return operation that made the link.
